content:
**1 Star – Worst Mattress Purchase Ever!**

This foam mattress was an absolute waste of money—it arrived with a strong chemical odor that lingered for *weeks*, despite airing it out. The "medium-firm" support advertised is a lie; it’s either rock-hard or sinks like quicksand depending on where you lie. Within a month, permanent body indentations formed, making it feel like sleeping in a hammock with zero spinal alignment. The edges collapse the second you sit on them, so forget about using the full surface—good luck not rolling off in the middle of the night. It sleeps *insanely* hot, even with breathable sheets, turning my bed into a sauna by 2 AM. The "hypoallergenic" claim is questionable, too—my allergies flared up worse than ever after switching to this thing. Customer service was useless when I tried to return it, citing some vague "30-day trial" loophole they refused to honor. Do yourself a favor and spend the extra cash on a *real* mattress—this one is a flimsy, overpriced disappointment.
